about: T-546 built: THE BLACKOUT (ROCK TUNNEL) in purple with threads of green -- B LIGHT IN THE SEAMS, the card B only the threads, and the dark (src/daemons_blackout.c). Entered from ROUTE 10 through its card; black with the dim threads before VERBOSE, the player and the follower only (WIN0 still hides the sprites beyond 24 px); a wild battle in the dark and back (no lit frame either way -- the bursts); VERBOSE, the purple rising with its circle; a few frames of the eight-second breath; a battle after and the light kept; B1F dark again (VERBOSE is per map); OTHER CAVE untouched (the threads hidden in its light). Debug scratch save. A DREAM LOG dream may come on the first step (T-412: a milestone the DEBUG save holds, dreamt at the first step after a dawn) -- the route takes a step and plays it out before it walks.
